reader_summary.overview: with Marc Andreessen (@pmarca), Ben Horowitz (@bhorowitz). Because you're then dividing up a smaller piece, adds Ben Horowitz, instead of growing the pie altogether. This is true not just in economics, politics, and tech, but also in business relationships (and life), too.

key_points.text: And speaking of such relationships, how does the partnership between Ben and Marc work, more than two decades later.
Where do they find the creative inspiration, information, and influences for new ideas?
